name: Dr Justin Olstein
title: Psychologist (Doctor of Psychology, Clinical)
description: With a focus on working with LGBTQIA+ clients... He primarily draws upon psychodynamic and schema therapy approaches. Assists adults with concerns including trauma, attachment issues, sexuality exploration/identification, gender dysphoria, minority stress, and sex/intimacy concerns. Sees both individuals and couples.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, schema therapy, psychodynamic, trauma, gender dysphoria, sexuality, sex/intimacy, couples

name: Debra (Deb) Anthony
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Deb is proud to provide a non-judgemental, sex positive and LGBTIQA+ affirming psychology service for all people, regardless of gender or sexuality or relationship types. Clinical Psychologist FACPA FCCLP MAPS AusPATH.
specialties: LGBTIQA+ affirming, sex positive, AusPATH member, clinical mental health

name: Dr Matt Brown
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I am passionate about working with individuals from LGBTQIA+ communities and adopt an LGBTQIA+ affirmative approach to my practice. Supports anxiety, depression, grief, relationship difficulties, identity exploration; also specialises in psycho-oncology. I currently provide Telehealth appointments only.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ affirmative, identity exploration, psycho-oncology, CBT

name: Clare Billings
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I'm Clare (she/they) and I'm a Clinical Psychologist living on Wurundjeri Land in Naarm. I offer counselling, assessment and treatment (including WPATH assessments) for 16-year-olds and above over telehealth. I strive to be neuro-affirming, LGBTIQAP+ inclusive.
specialties: WPATH assessments, LGBTIQAP+ inclusive, neuro-affirming, telehealth

name: Julian Nolan
title: Clinical Psychologist & Family Therapist
description: I specialise in servicing the LGBT+ community, including individual, couples and family therapy for a range of conditions and concerns. I also provide Autism/ADHD assessments, and WPATH letters.
specialties: LGBT+, couples and family therapy, WPATH letters, autism/ADHD assessment

name: Laura Kemppainen
title: Psychologist
description: Laura is a registered psychologist who works with LGBTQIA+ clients in Fitzroy, with experience in trauma, substance use, and eating and body-image concerns. Prior to private practice she worked at Drummond street services, including seeing clients from Queer space.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, trauma, substance use, eating and body image

name: Dr Elise Landau
title: Psychologist; Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist
description: LGBTQIA+ ally with over a decade of work within the community, including gender identity stress, pre- and post-op gender confirmation surgery, and discrimination trauma. I work with clients of all relationship orientations including monogamous, open, and poly- couples. I'm kink, sex, and sex work positive too.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, couples therapy, polyamory, kink positive, sex positive, insomnia

name: Malan van der Walt
title: Psychologist
description: AHPRA-registered psychologist with over 10 years' experience supporting adults and adolescents, especially LGBTQIA+ communities and neurodivergent people, with concerns like anxiety, low mood, ADHD, trauma and big life changes. Telehealth across Victoria or in-person in Oak Park.
